description.value: Flipside Burgers is a gourmet burger food truck permanently stationed at Aframe Brewing in Squamish, BC, serving beef, chicken, and vegetarian burgers built from local BC ingredients. Cyclists can order from the outdoor Take Out window without entering the brewery, or opt for patio dine-in by purchasing a beverage inside Aframe first. The pairing of craft beer and scratch-made burgers in an outdoor setting makes it a popular rest stop on Squamish's busy cycling corridor.
